children: Copper has surged to an all-time high near $6.85 a pound, making the copper inside old U.S. pennies worth several times face value.
The metal broke above a seven-month ascending triangle as traders weighed tight supply against demand from electrification, power grids and data centers.
Euro Pacific Capital chief economist Peter Schiff highlighted the coin math. A pre-1982 penny now contains 4.46 cents of copper, he calculated.

Even modern zinc-core pennies contain 1.07 cents of metal, Schiff said. He called pennies a risk-free store of value with more upside than Treasuries because face value is fixed while metal prices can rise.
Why Copper's Penny Trade Is Mostly Symbolic

But the trade is not practically risk-free. Federal restrictions limit melting or exporting U.S. pennies for metal, while storing, transporting and selling quantities of coins would create significant costs.
A penny's calculated melt value therefore is not equivalent to readily accessible cash. The exercise instead illustrates how dramatically copper's commodity price has increased.

For investors, the more important development is the technical breakout after seven months of price compression. Ascending triangles can signal that buyers are repeatedly absorbing supply at resistance, but confirmation requires copper to hold above its former ceiling.

The fundamental story also has two reinforcing narratives. Copper is an essential industrial material for electric vehicles, grids and data-center construction. It can simultaneously attract investors seeking protection against inflation or currency debasement.

The United States Copper Index Fund (CPER) offers exposure to copper futures, while the Global X Copper Miners ETF (COPX) owns mining companies. Miner shares can provide greater upside when copper rises but introduce operating, political and cost risks.

Investors should watch whether the breakout attracts sustained volume and whether physical demand supports the move. A quick reversal below prior resistance would weaken the signal, while continued strength could establish a higher long-term trading range.

title: Copper Breakout Gives Ordinary Pennies Stunning New Value
